entities.summary: Maj Gen Mohamud Muse Hersi (Somali: Maxamuud Muuse Xirsi Cadde, Arabic: محمد موسى حرسي; 1 July 1937 – 8 February 2017), AKA Adde Musa, was a Somali military official and former President of Puntland from 8 January 2005 to 8 January 2009.
